In The realm of hungry ghost book by gabor matte in hindi

In this solo podcast episode, I dive into In the Realm of Hungry Ghosts by Dr. Gabor Maté, a powerful exploration of addiction, trauma, and the human condition. This book offers profound insights into the roots of addiction, emphasizing compassion, understanding, and the need for systemic change. Join me as I break down key lessons, share impactful takeaways, and discuss how these insights can transform our perspectives on addiction and healing. Whether you're familiar with the book or new to its concepts, this episode promises thought-provoking reflections. Tune in and let’s explore together!
